title: Worship Service - Sunday, August 2nd at North Clubhouse
summary: PALM HILL SUNDAY WORSHIP SERVICE North Rec Hall Sunday, August 2 at 4:00pm.(doors open at 3:30) Please come and join us in Fellowship, Songs, Scripture and Communion. This is a non-denominational service and ALL are welcome. Our mission is to provide a place for all to connect with God. Our purpose is to Love God, Love People, Reach Up, Reach Out, and Reach In. PLEASE COME AND JOIN US!
